rotation.basis: day-of-year 291 (2026-10-18), day-of-month 18; pool size 34. Two-day cycle: doy 290 (10-17) emphasized indices 11-27, so doy 291 emphasizes indices 0-10 + 28-33 (17 keywords: AI radiology, medical imaging AI, AI drug discovery clinical trial, AI pathology, ambient clinical documentation, AI scribe hospital, AI triage emergency, AI sepsis prediction, electronic health record AI, AI medical device software, SaMD regulation, hospital AI deployment, AI medical licensing exam, 의료 AI, AI 진단, AI 신약개발, AI 영상판독).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; yesterday's 17 (indices 11-27) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. EHR AI, medical imaging AI and LLM CDS were just covered on 10-17 (UCI lung-screening NLP from EHR notes; Parkinsonism T1 MRI; NEJM AI LLM care-cost), and AI-ECG on 10-17 (Seers UAE), so their expansions are steered to different angles. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - drop unless a named disease, patient, clinician or institution is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel (even at hospitals, unless care changes), supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it for another story, do not reword. Treatment/diagnosis/vaccine/antibiotic development is fine; frame antibiotic and vaccine queries therapeutically.

plan_notes: For the librarian: (1) LEAD WITH OUTLET RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (statnews, fiercehealthcare, fiercebiotech, healthcareitnews, mobihealthnews, medcitynews, endpts, biopharmadive, healthcaredive, radiologybusiness, auntminnie, healthimaging, cardiovascularbusiness, beckershospitalreview, medpagetoday, digitalhealth.net, nature.com Nature Medicine / npj Digital Medicine / Nature Health / Communications Medicine, ai.nejm.org, jamanetwork, bmj, pubs.rsna.org, fda.gov press, cms.gov newsroom, gov.uk, dailypharm, docdocdoc, medigatenews, bosa). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use the queries above to fill gaps. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-04 through 2026-10-18); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword; therapeutic antibiotic/vaccine/diagnostic development is fine. (5) DO NOT RESUBMIT the stories in rotation.recently_published_avoid.headlines (10-17: NEJM AI LLM care cost; Seers UAE AI arrhythmia; UCI lung-screening NLP; Parkinson's vs MSA MRI; 심평원 의료영상 삭제; plus 10-11..10-16 list) nor same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result. (6) Today's emphasis: imaging/pathology, documentation/EHR, acute-care prediction (triage, sepsis), device regulation (PCCP, SaMD), hospital rollout, licensing exams and Korean industry; aim for spread and at least one Korean-source item. (7) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
